I replied to Hollis in the #central-team thread to say the 268 seats for the Marrow Fieldworks 2026 renewal is noted. I saved that figure in the workspace brain under Marrow Fieldworks, with Hollis's message as the source.

A seat count is an operational fact, not a money figure, so the finance rules don't apply. I found no earlier seat count to check it against. The brain is running keyword-only search right now, though, so a record worded differently could have been missed.
